name: @veren/startup-autostart
description: Use when DeepSeek Harness must do something by itself every time it starts - create a session, resume one, wake one with a message, or leave a message in its inbox - with every enabled item running on every successful start and no debounce, because a restart interrupts the work the previous start began; skip it when the work is time-based (that is @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule) or must run only once.
